The meeting will be with Google's Vice President of Trust & Safety Laurie Richardson and Shane
Huntley, Google's TAG director. Alphabet reps will discuss: 1) proactive outreach and work; 2)
threats seen throughout the campaign; and 3) looking ahead to 2024 and lessons learned.
Attendees:
State (GEC, CDP, DRL, WHA, EUR, SCA, AF, CT, INR)
USAID
DHS
For visitors:
• Visitors to connect with GEC POC (Alexis Frisbie) upon arrival
• Advise arriving 20 minutes prior to meeting to permit ample time to check in
• Enter at
(Visitor's Entrance just to the left of the main C St. entrance)
• Standard x-ray and metal detector for visitors
• ID's required/submitted to front desk where visitors will receive "Escort Required" badges; GEC will
act as escort
• Briefing room 1408 reserved from 1:00 - 2:45 to ensure flexibility
Please let me know if you have any questions!
